O.outcome_detail: competence and confidence affecting prescribing and management

cells.quote: Lack of education, training and insufficient exposure to clozapine management were significant factors impacting competence and confidence, resulting in clozapine underuse and variance in prescribing practice.
cells.note: The exposure comparison is synthesized across included studies rather than experimentally assigned.

D.comparison: confidence adhering to guidelines and managing side effects

cells.quote: HCPs self-reported as competent with guidelines (local and national), yet they expressed less confidence in their ability to adhere to them and were uncertain about managing side effects.
cells.note: This is a reported competence-confidence discrepancy; the review cautions that self-reported competence may overestimate actual competence.
